newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-RECORDS SET BY WOODS IN MASTERS TRIUMPH.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-RECORDS SET BY WOODS IN MASTERS TRIUMPH.

text.p: Records set by Tiger Woods in winning the 61st Masters Touranament:
-- Youngest winner at age 21, eclipsing Seve Ballesteros's mark set in 1980 by nearly two years
-- Low 72-hole score of 18-under-par 270, beating shared mark of 271 set by Jack Nicklaus (1965) and Raymond Floyd (1976)
-- Widest winning margin of 12 strokes, surpassing nine-shot victory by Nicklaus in 1965
-- Total for last 54 holes, 66-65-69 for 200, improving on Johnny Miller's 71-65-66 for 202 in 1975.
-- Total for second and third holes, 66-65 for 131, erasing Nick Prices's mark of 69-63 for 132 in 1986
-- Total for first 54 holes, 201 (70-66-65), tied Floyd (1976)
